mapper.select: select tp.template_point_id, tp.template_id, tp.route_id, tp.point_id, tp.point_name, p.gcj02_lng, p.gcj02_lat, p.bd09_lng, p.bd09_lat, p.wgs84_lng, p.wgs84_lat, tp.sequence, tp.required_flag, tp.remark from biz_task_template_point tp left join biz_scene_point p on p.point_id = tp.point_id and p.del_flag = '0' where tp.del_flag = '0' and tp.template_id = #{templateId} order by tp.sequence asc, tp.template_point_id asc
